final: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifacts FROM scanfeatures), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, 1.0 * articount / total.artifacts AS share FROM scanfeatures CROSS JOIN total WHERE articount IS NOT NULL AND total.artifacts IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT shares.zoneref, shares.articount, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.share AS difference FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE average_share.share IS NOT NULL AND shares.share > average_share.share ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
